tools.name: chain_query
tools.description: 查当日治理链事件清单（哈希、事件型、主体字段）。Query one day's governance chain events (hash, event type, subject). 承接 CLI：sih-engine/target/debug/scribe query --trail。正典：sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md；sih-engine/sih/state/plan/mcpline-line-v1.md

tools.name: chain_verify
tools.description: 验当日治理链：逐笔哈希校验与整链 valid 判词。Verify one day's chain: per-event hash checks and whole-chain valid verdict. 承接 CLI：scribe verify --trail。正典：sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md；sih-engine/sih/state/plan/mcpline-line-v1.md

tools.name: critsweep
tools.description: 判据扫：GOV-002 五判据三态、泊界两线路由、两账本在飞，严格 JSON 单对象。Criterion sweep: five GOV-002 criteria tri-state, parking routing, two in-flight ledgers. 承接 CLI：python3 sih-tools/critsweep/sweep.py --at <date> --root <root>。正典：sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md；sih-engine/sih/state/plan/mcpline-line-v1.md

tools.name: heartbeat
tools.description: 心跳：秤星三维最新读数与距上快照间隔日（只读不落链）。Heartbeat: latest gauge tri-dimension readings and days since last snapshot (read-only). 承接 CLI：cd sih-tools/gauge 且 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m gauge.cli read。正典：sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md；sih-engine/sih/state/plan/mcpline-line-v1.md

tools.name: locks_read
tools.description: 锁面读数：未释放锁成对核算与活跃会话数。Locks reading: unreleased lock accounting and active session count. 承接 CLI：uv run --project sih-tools/lease lease status（查册）。正典：sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md；sih-engine/sih/state/plan/mcpline-line-v1.md

tools.name: naming_guide
tools.description: 立名指引：司衡命名动作程序与纪律静态教学五段（立名五步形、DEC-017 修订指针、检词六态语义、stem 闸拒教认领三语义、死档禁条），只读零裁决。Naming guide: static five-section teaching for naming actions, read-only, zero adjudication. 正典：DEC-017；立名 skill；pk-090。

tools.name: nomenclator_query
tools.description: 查词：术语六态查询（已立、懒波、死档、候补、未知）附出处指针，只读投影 nomenclator query。命名动作前查册义务的机械承载位。

tools.name: nomenclator_check
tools.description: 文档核查：死档禁字级与懒波词两规则字符串级检出，行号与摘录入报告，只读投影 nomenclator check。

tools.name: retriever_recall
tools.description: 温故检索：治理档案四轴检索（topic 主题轴、word 文轴、event 事件轴、time 时间轴），stdout NDJSON 原文透传与退出码三值透传，只读投影 retriever recall，只报不判。Retrieve governance archive facets on four axes (topic/word/event/time) with verbatim NDJSON and exit-code passthrough; read-only projection, reports without judging. 承接 CLI：sih-engine/target/debug/retriever recall ... --root <域根>，cwd 不承根以 --root 显式传。正典：sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md 与 sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-007-project-memory-component.md；sih-engine/sih/state/plan/mcpline-line-v1.md

tools.name: lease_open
tools.description: lease open：立约开工立本连接的 lease 会话（一连接恰好一会话），以 server 进程正身件签发，会话号经本工具结果透出记录；意图闸（ask3 验收）与同包活跃闸与施工面预检原位。 lease open: establish this connection's single lease session with the server process identity; session id is returned in the result. 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md

tools.name: record_intent
tools.description: record intent：追加意图精炼事件（写），闸二重意图拒（同 record 路径唯一意图笔）与闸三会话在册验原位；plain 形（零哲学引文）validation 豁免，ask3 形验证件必填（DES-016）。 record intent: append an intent event via the existing scribe gates (re-intent and session-in-ledger checks in place); plain form (zero philosophy quotes) omits validation, ask3 form requires it (DES-016). 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md

tools.name: record_append
tools.description: record append：追加认证事件（写），闸三会话在册验原位；本操作无幂等闸，重放同 report 即重复认证笔（信封审计可检出）。 record append: append a certification event via the existing session gate; no idempotency gate (declared). 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md

tools.name: record_park
tools.description: record park：追加停泊事件（写），停泊记录 JSON 透传。 record park: append a parking event via the existing scribe CLI. 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md

tools.name: lease_lock
tools.description: lease lock：租内取锁，悲观五验（在册、择定、范围、身份、绑定）原位；撞锁即 locked_elsewhere 拒或 wait 入队受理返位次。 lease lock: acquire a path lock; five in-place verifications; conflicts surface locked_elsewhere or queue position. 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md

tools.name: lease_unlock
tools.description: lease unlock：放锁，同一五验加持锁验原位。 lease unlock: release a path lock with the in-place verifications. 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md

tools.name: lease_wait_turn
tools.description: lease wait-turn：排队阻塞至轮到并取锁（机械轮询，timeout 到即如实返退出码与出队事实）。 lease wait-turn: block until your turn then acquire; timeout surfaces the dequeue fact as-is. 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md

tools.name: lease_claim
tools.description: lease claim：领取登记（声明位非执法位），同包未过期在领即 PackageAlreadyClaimed 拒。 lease claim: declaration-style claim on a package; duplicate active claims are rejected. 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md

tools.name: lease_commit
tools.description: lease commit：提交即四验后机械 message 落笔；settle 须 seq 与 cert（链上认证哈希）。 lease commit: mechanical commit after the in-place four verifications; settle requires seq and cert. 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md

tools.name: lease_close
tools.description: lease close：收约（锁清零、分支归并删支、拆本吊销），受 close 链闸与 closeguard 约束；强拆与绕行旗标不透传。 lease close: close the session; chain gate and closeguard apply; force and bypass flags are never forwarded. 设计正典：sih-engine/doc/design/DES-014-mcp-beta-security-model-v1.md；sih-engine/doc/spec/SPEC-023-mcpline-alpha-readonly-v1.md
